ideas.title: The land yacht rolls: let the sail's solved force push it down the beach
ideas.critique: The real step is that the still yacht from last session moves for the first time, with solved sail force at apparent wind against Bekker rolling resistance, and stall and soft sand both come from the physics. If the film is yet another fixed camera watching a device go by itself, it falls into the same form as the last ten posts. The sheet the player trims is what lifts it out of that.

ideas.title: Wool on the sail: telltales the player trims by
ideas.critique: Threads that show a hidden flow field is the iron-filings and compass payoff again, made of wool. On a sail that cannot move or be trimmed yet, it is something to look at with nothing to steer, so reading it pays off nothing.

ideas.title: A boom and a sheet: the sail swings when the wind shifts
ideas.critique: A hinged spar with a rope is a joint and a constraint, solid but expected. The thump of a gybe is the only moment in it, and on a cart that does not roll yet, the lurch has nothing to act on.

ideas.title: Spoked oak wheels turned on Lumi's own lathe
ideas.critique: Generated wheel parts and a rim width fed into one sinkage formula make a prop plus a parameter. The payoff, variants side by side ending differently, is the island's most worn recipe, and ruts alone are not a game.

ideas.title: Lumi gets a sailor's habit: licking a wing feather to feel the wind
ideas.critique: This is the only pitch where Lumi's own body and character carry the idea, and the gesture could become a recognisable habit. The cooling physics is decoration on a shiver animation, though, and the player gets almost nothing to do.

ideas.title: The yacht capsizes when you hold on too tight
ideas.critique: Friends tumbling off a yacht that tips over is the clip people would share, and it gives the sheet a risk. Made before the yacht can roll, it is a static moment-balance rig toppled once, and it leans on the wreck-it payoff.

ideas.title: Sand blowing off the dune past the yacht
ideas.nearest: Dandelion clocks, a take that misses
ideas.critique: Saltation from friction velocity is a new particle system on the GPU, which the island lacks. Waiting for strong wind is not a goal, so this is something to watch, and the sand-fence step it gestures at is not built.

ideas.title: The friends race their own driftwood yachts
ideas.critique: Shape variants of one thing let go side by side to see who wins is the darts, logs and putting recipe again, with friends cheering on top. Friends using what Lumi made is the only fresh part.

ideas.title: Patch the torn sail
ideas.critique: A porous region switched off in a flow solve, measured as a force number, is a one-off before/after with no player payoff unless the yacht already runs on that force.

ideas.title: Dusk run: the yacht's dynamo lights a lantern as it rolls
ideas.critique: A glowing filament driven by the motor run backwards puts the glowing wire and the motor together, which is the recent pots-motor-wire run again. It also depends on a yacht that does not roll yet, so it cannot come first.
